Every uploaded file should say where it comes from and who may use it. When you upload with [[Special:Upload]], pick a licence from the '''Licensing''' list and its box is added to the file page for you. To fix or add one later, edit the file page and put one of these under == Licensing ==. {| class="wikitable" ! Template !! Means !! Category !! Optional values |- | {{Screenshot}} || In-game screenshot || [[:Category:In-game screenshots]] || 1 = the game, if not GTA V; 2 = who owns it. |- | {{Self}} || Own work, shared under CC BY-SA 4.0 || [[:Category:Own work]] || 1 = your name, to be credited. |- | {{Permission}} || Used with the creator's permission || [[:Category:Files used with permission]] || 1 = who gave permission. |- | {{Server}} || Official Let's RP material || [[:Category:Official Let's RP files]] || |- | {{Fair use}} || Copyrighted, used as fair use || [[:Category:Fair use files]] || 1 = who owns the copyright. |- | {{CC-BY-SA-4.0}} || Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 || [[:Category:CC BY-SA 4.0 files]] || 1 = the creator, to be credited. |- | {{CC-BY-4.0}} || Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 || [[:Category:CC BY 4.0 files]] || 1 = the creator, to be credited. |- | {{CC0}} || Public domain || [[:Category:Public domain files]] || |- | {{No license}} || No licence given || [[:Category:Files with no license]] || |} Which one? * '''Screenshots and clips from the game''' (even ones you took yourself): {{Screenshot}}. The game's pictures belong to Rockstar. * '''Your own drawing, edit or photo''': {{Self}} to let anyone reuse it, or {{Permission|your name}} to keep it to this wiki. * '''Someone else's art''' (a commission, stream art): ask them first, then {{Permission|their name}}. * '''Real-world logos, album covers, film posters''': {{Fair use|owner}}, at a small size. Files tagged {{No license}} are listed in [[:Category:Files with no license]] (hidden) for moderators to check. The list on the upload page is set in [[MediaWiki:Licenses]]. All licence templates use [[Template:License]] for their box, styled by [[Template:License/styles.css]]. == The shared box == {{License|kind=…|title=…|text=…|category=…}}: kind sets the colour (game, free, permission, fairuse, none). The category is only added on file pages. [[Category:Files by license]]
